data.gender_notes: Leebanun is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A beautiful name for a girl, derived from the Arabic word 'Leeb' meaning 'light' and the suffix 'Anun' meaning 'of Allah'. The name Leebanun carries the meaning “Light of Allah” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Leebanun usually hope their child will grow to embody light of allah and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Leebanun is a spiritual name that represents the blessings and grace of Allah. It is believed that those named Leebanun are blessed with the qualities of generosity, kindness, and beauty.
data.etymology: Leebanun belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Light of Allah.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Leebanun total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_urdu.name: لیبانون

in_hindi.name: लीबानुन
